questions.question: What does the woman do at night in chapter 3?
options: Sleeps soundly until the morning light
Seeks the one her soul loves through the city
Sings songs of joy to the dawn
Travels far to a distant land
questions.answer: Seeks the one her soul loves through the city

questions.question: What grand sight is described at the end of chapter 3?
options: A great battle on the plain
A sudden storm over the hills
A vineyard heavy with much ripe fruit

questions.question: In chapter 3 the bride says she found him whom her soul loves and would not let him go.
On my bed at night I sought the one I _____; I sought him, but did not find him.
Behold, it is _____ carriage, escorted by sixty mighty men of Israel.
